description: Find traffic-carrying pages for a domain and route them into protect, refresh, expand, or recover actions. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

historical_serp_mode.description: Whether to use live, lost or all supported historical search-ranking observations. Type: String. Accepted values: "live", "lost", "all". Default: "live".

language.description: Supported search language code, for example en for English. Type: String. Default: "en".

limit.description: Maximum number of traffic-carrying page records to return. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 10. Maximum: 250. Default: 50.

location.description: Supported geographic search-market name, for example United States; this is not a coordinate pair. Type: String. Default: "United States".

location_code.description: Numeric provider location identifier for the search market; the service validates support alongside the location name. Type: Safe integer. Must be greater than 0. Optional; no client default.

min_traffic.description: Minimum estimated monthly organic search visits a page must have; zero disables this lower-bound filter. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 0. Maximum: 10000000. Default: 0.

sort_by.description: Metric used to order returned results; choose one of this tool’s accepted enum values. Type: String. Accepted values: "estimated_traffic", "keyword_count", "top3", "opportunity". Default: "estimated_traffic".

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

target.description: Target domain, subdomain or absolute page URL to analyze; use a hostname or URL, not a business name. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Required.

name: agentseo_domain_relevant_pages
title: AgentSEO Domain Relevant Pages
